nodes.label: Rainbow Options (Trade Data)
nodes.rationale: Rainbow options can be represented either as traditional (Equity/Fx/Commodity)RainbowOption trades or as ScriptedTrade instances sharing a payoff script library, so the same product concept has two alternative XML encodings.

nodes.label: Best Of Asset Or Cash Rainbow Option
Worst Of Asset Or Cash Rainbow Option
Rainbow Call Spread Option (European / Barrier / Asian variants)
Worst Performance Rainbow Option (01/02/03)
nodes.rationale: Versions 01-03 progressively add a payoff multiplier, a floor, and a knock-in barrier feature on top of the same worst-performance-of-basket payoff.

nodes.label: Rate Digital Option
nodes.rationale: Designed to hedge/replicate Range Accrual coupons by decomposing each daily rate observation into a digital option on the rate.

nodes.label: Scripted Trade Product Catalog (Trade Data)
nodes.rationale: A catalog of miscellaneous exotic products (volatility barriers, CMS-linked structures, cliquets, forward starting options) each implemented as a distinct ScriptedTrade payoff script.

nodes.label: European Volatility Barrier Option / Dual European Binary Option with Volatility Barrier
Scripted Trade Data Node & Script Library (Appendix)
nodes.rationale: Documents the ScriptedTradeData container, external Data node, and script library mechanism that lets many trades share one centrally maintained payoff script, making new products a configuration change rather than a code release.

nodes.label: Payment Currency Convention in Scripted Trades (natural vs quanto payoff)
Non-Deliverable / Indexed Cash-Settled Swap
nodes.rationale: Non-deliverable currency swaps are represented by setting Settlement=Cash, Currency to the deliverable currency, Notional in the non-deliverable amount, and adding an fx Indexing on each leg to convert flows.

nodes.label: Swaption Straddle
nodes.rationale: Only one side (payer or receiver swaption) needs to be booked; ORE internally creates the mirror-image Swaption with reversed leg directions to form the straddle.

nodes.label: TaRF Scripted Trade Representation
nodes.rationale: The scripted representation of a TaRF does not support time-varying strikes/range bounds or a target-amount-in-points specification available in the traditional FxTaRFData/EquityTaRFData/CommodityTaRFData form.
